Three source files name the `PlanLimits` type:

- **`src/config/plan-limits.ts`**: defines the interface (line 13) and uses it in the type of `PLAN_LIMITS` (`Readonly<Record<PlanId, PlanLimits>>`, line 29) and in the return type of `getPlanLimits` (line 107). Each plan entry in `PLAN_LIMITS` will need a value for the new field.
- **`src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx`**: imports `type PlanLimits` (line 16) and uses it for the `limits` prop (line 27).
- **`src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts`**: imports `type PlanLimits` (line 9) and uses it in the hook's return type (line 14).

The dozens of other files that import from `@/config/plan-limits` only call `getPlanLimits`, `wouldExceedLimit`, `getLimit`, `UNLIMITED` or `planAtLeast`, and never write the type name, so they're out of scope. The word also appears inside strings in `scripts/build-manifest.ts`, `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts` and the test name at `tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts:77`, but those strings aren't used as types. Nothing else refers to the type another way: no `typeof PLAN_LIMITS`, no `ReturnType<typeof getPlanLimits>`, no renamed import, and no barrel file that re-exports it.

ANSWER: src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts
